true_orochi_team_enable_help: Pair two profiles on this computer and backend. Enable on both and run both True Orochi tasks together. Rooms are invitation-only. Disabled preserves solo play.
true_orochi_role_help: Choose one initial leader and one member. The actual host can change according to the plan and available entries.
true_orochi_teammate_config_help: Enter the other profile name without .json. Both profiles must point to each other and list the other's in-game friend name for OCR invitations.
true_orochi_hosting_mode_help: Uses the initial leader's setting. Random draws one shared plan per week. A host without an entry is replaced by its partner. If neither has an entry, defer; team mode does not farm soul ten to discover entries.
exit_four_help: At 0, 9, 18 and 27 completed normal attacks in this task run, independently trigger with 50% probability. Randomly choose an unattacked opponent, retreat four times, then fight normally. Normal wins and losses count; deliberate retreats do not. Refreshing preserves progress and each milestone is checked once. Skip when no unattacked target is available.
